capacityClass: p.40 publishes no single capacity-class scalar; '25' is a model size code, not a published kW class label

controlStrategy (inverter/on-off): not published as a table row
current 2026 availability of FTXZ-N (2022 edition identity): unknown; dated historical coverage, not a claim of the current 2026 range
indoor refrigerant charge/piping/operating range: belong to outdoor unit (RXZ), not duplicated here
